notes: Governed Chromium extension allowlist. Set enabled=true and add absolute (or repo-relative) paths to 'load': an unpacked extension folder, a .zip, or a .crx (CRX2/CRX3) — all three are accepted (universal adapter; zip/crx are unpacked once into runtime/extensions_cache/<sha256>/). Listing a path here is NOT enough to load it: every resolved folder must also pass the governance load gate (scripts/recognition_extension_governance_v1.ps1 -Action verify), which only succeeds if an operator has already run '-Action register' for those EXACT bytes and the policy (config/extension_policy.v1.json) decided 'allow'. Registering is a separate, explicit step — the browser never auto-registers or auto-allows an extension. Examples: "C:/ext/ublock", "extensions/my-ext.zip", "extensions/my-ext.crx".
